claim.catalog_branch: post-arrival execution of a later mission only
claim.observed_subject: native-log numeric identity <TEACH-AIR-01,0> in one accepted run
claim.bounded_statement: The original accepted aircraft ID 0 leaves TEACH-UNIT at h10.5, arrives and becomes ready at TEACH-UNIT-2 at h11, is allocated to the later TEACH-GROUP mission at h19, flies at h20, performs the h20.5-21.5 task, completes the mission at h22, and is ready at the target unit after turnround.
excluded_claims: the full I04.var09 variant or every OR branch
a general system identity or transfer-priority law
an inferred person identity or hidden engine state
a new native behavior discovery or accepted-parent rerun
GUI, performance, cross-engine, or other source combinations

independent_reuse_feasibility.role: reviewer scope guidance, not postrun classification approval

catalog_identity_and_aliases.comparison_rule: Read-only contract gate binds current 498 exact bytes; later sealed classification replays compare original 496 typed metadata/prefix and globally unique publication IDs, while retaining all distinct local CRLF and Git LF historical byte identities. Never assert normalized text means byte equality.

authored_source_and_report_scope.system_deployment: SystemDeployment has one TEACH-AIR-01 at TEACH-UNIT and one at TEACH-UNIT-2; numeric aircraft ID 0 is observed in the native log, not inferred from the source row alone.
authored_source_and_report_scope.full_report_acceptance_location: Prior accepted independent GO and original raw byte pin; the new classifier may check selected original cells but must not claim to have freshly replayed all 4044 cells.

required_inputs: current catalog and distinct historical archives
custody_gate: Rehash the 401 indexed source_files, the index itself, 153 mandatory raw originals and 15 separate mandatory preflight originals; rehash the root-selected 403 current disk/Git pair identities without collapsing aliases.

Verify all 456 prelaunch manifest role pins; when two roles resolve to one physical path require identical size and SHA. Preserve two unrelated-chat private originals as mandatory local-only and never copy them into a publishable artifact.
Bind the exact original run ID, source input, closure, full report raw SHA, and independent GO. Neither import the old checker nor execute old source/native/checker commands.

full_log_gate.grammar: Parse every original line, including continuation and non-Time lines; reject unknown or extra lines, duplicate timed edges, changed mission IDs, wrong IDs/units/times, and departures/arrivals outside the declared causal order. An exact-byte pin alone is not the new semantic result.

causal_edges.edge: ID0 ready at TEACH-UNIT; ID1 ready at TEACH-UNIT-2
first group mission allocates both IDs
first mission starts with both IDs
first mission succeeds and ID0 returns ready at TEACH-UNIT
ID0 ready count decreases once at source, then same ID transfers out
same ID0 transfers in at target, then target ready count increases once
later mission activates requesting two, allocates ID1 and the same arrived ID0 from target
later mission succeeds/completes; ID0 turns round and returns ready at target

state_equations: For each numeric ID, roster owner is exactly one of source, target, or transit at each event microstep; a mission assignment is a separate state from unit roster ownership.
ID0 source -> transit exactly once at h10.5, transit -> target exactly once at h11; never source-and-target simultaneously.
No mission allocation while an ID is in transit; allocation requires prior ready state at the corresponding unit; each release/ready transition is balanced to the same mission and ID.
Track ready, mission-assigned, mission-active, task-active and turnround per ID; conservation is two distinct numeric IDs, with no invented outside pool or third aircraft.
full_log_gate.terminal: At the accepted final h22 ready event, both numeric IDs are ready under target roster ownership; no pending transfer or mission allocation is asserted by the observed final log.

new_classifier.report_read_rule: Parse the original native report with its one declared trailing-comma punctuation repair, reject duplicate keys/nonfinite numbers/extra structure/bool-as-number, verify selected cell types and values, and separately pin the entire raw byte stream plus prior 4044-cell GO. Do not re-run the accepted report oracle.
new_classifier.negative_harness_layer: Sealed reader first checks original SHA/size and provenance. In-memory private clones then call the new classifier semantic parser/ledger directly with the outer byte-pin check intentionally separated, so a wrong ID/time/owner or reordered edge fails its own invariant rather than only the original SHA check. No accepted original is modified and no accepted checker is invoked.
meaningful_negative_clones: arrival before departure or wrong time/unit
changed numeric identity at transfer-in, ready, allocation, flight, task, completion, or terminal
simultaneous source/target or allocation during transit
wrong first/later mission identity or extra mission edge
missing return/ready, duplicate ready, wrong terminal owner
unknown/extra log line or malformed continuation, while preservation pins are separately controlled
selected report cell one-unit mutation after a synthetic reseal; bool substituted for declared numeric; duplicate JSON key; nonfinite numeric; extra row/table

review_and_publication_gates: Independent GO_CONTRACT_ONLY on this exact prospective classification contract before creating a package or executable reader.
Independent frozen classifier method and meaningful pure negative checks before root freezes any new source inventory; no native/SSH/preflight.
Original read-only classifier capture and independent bounded review against the unchanged accepted run; the classification may fail without changing accepted behavior status.

Separate source/raw/content/catalog/Git publication gates; any publication entry states new_native_runs as integer 0 and accepted_parent_runs_repeated as integer 0, and identifies reclassification of existing evidence rather than a new simulation result.
